gallery.title: File:Aaron Ward 1923.jpg
gallery.description:
Original caption: Aaron Ward, second sacker of the Yankees, is put out at third, just a close bit of action from the first game in the new Yankee Stadium in New York yesterday, when 74,000 shivering fans saw Babe Ruth bust out a homer and the New Yorkers defeat the Boston Red Sox by 4 to 1. This happened in the fourth inning. 4/19/23. 
Image courtesy of the New York Public Library (NYPL.org), "The Pageant of America" Collection / v.15 - Annals of American sport / (unpublished photographs) / Baseball.
